not_selected.active_site_encoder_feature_work: Not first: current hand geometry resolves the audited heldout join gap; encoder feature work should wait for a frozen geometry-router contract.
not_selected.fair_decoder_rerun: Needed before learned-representation claims, but currently blocked for ProtT5/SaProt by missing local sidecars/weights.
not_selected.family_expansion: Not first: expansion would not fix the immediate decoder and geometry-join comparison confounds.

rationale: The geometry baseline re-export joins all 140 standardized heldout rows and removes the prior 5-row preview join gap.

With the existing calibrated geometry abstention threshold, hand-scored geometry is 45/45 on canonical primary rows and 0/92 false positives on pure out-of-scope rows; only secondary OOD probes are nonabstained because they are real registry fingerprints.
ESM-C logistic versus ESM-C cosine demonstrates decoder confounding, and ProtT5/SaProt matched logistic reruns are blocked by missing raw sidecars rather than by a model result.
The geometry-feature logistic probe is useful as a local sanity check, but it does not displace the hand-scored geometry router under the current evidence.

decoder_confound_example.interpretation: Decoder choice materially changes the ESM-C conclusion; SaProt and ProtT5 NN/cosine readouts are not fair peers for ESM-2/ESM-C logistic heads until raw sidecars enable matched logistic heads.

abstention_policy.semantics: top1_score < threshold => abstain; threshold not changed in this audit

geometry_baseline_reexport.join_policy: left join standardized heldout rows to full geometry retrieval by entry_id; never drop heldout rows

calibration.policy: lowest max-probability threshold with zero nonprimary/OOS false positives on calibration rows; no heldout threshold tuning

geometry_feature_logistic_head.feature_source: raw geometry descriptors plus per-fingerprint geometry retrieval components; no names, EC, mechanism text, labels, imports, or heldout labels as features
geometry_feature_logistic_head.model: sklearn LogisticRegression + StandardScaler; primary-class classifier with calibration-only abstention threshold

train_cal_split.stratify_label: primary fingerprint ids plus collapsed secondary_ood_probe plus out_of_scope

fold_conflict_oos_hard_negative.definition: Rows in v3_wave1_2 slice contract with use_status == oos_fold_conflict_hard_negative_candidate.

prott5.blocker: No ProtT5 raw embedding H5/sidecar or local model weights were found in the main repo or local cache inventory; the existing ProtT5 track is a coverage-biased Swiss-Prot H5 cosine/NN readout with 8 heldout rows missing.
prott5.requested_treatment: same logistic-head protocol as ESM-2 on current702 train/cal, heldout final-only
runnable_spec_without_download: Required implementation: add a read-only current702 embedding sidecar builder consuming artifacts/v3_sequence_manifest_current702_repaired_20260525.json with --backend prott5 --local-files-only and output only artifacts/*prott5*embedding_sidecar*.jsonl.
Then train the ESM-2-style logistic head on in_distribution train/cal only and evaluate heldout final-only.

saprot.blocker: No SaProt weights, raw embedding sidecar, or full current702 structure-token sidecar were found locally; the existing SaProt track is a nearest-neighbor structure-token readout, not a logistic-head readout.
saprot.requested_treatment: same logistic-head protocol as ESM-2 on current702 train/cal, heldout final-only
runnable_spec_without_download: Required implementation: add a read-only current702 SaProt token/embedding sidecar builder using artifacts/v3_foldseek_coordinate_readiness_1000_current702_wave1_20260527.json and the sequence manifest with --local-files-only and no label joins during vectorization.
Then train the ESM-2-style logistic head on in_distribution train/cal only and evaluate heldout final-only.

scope.objective: Determine whether Wave 1 representation conclusions are confounded by decoder choice and geometry join policy before further family expansion or encoder architecture decisions.
